labels.description: Adds a new passage on tariffs and other trade restrictions raising imported raw material and component costs, disrupting supply chains, limiting access to end markets, lowering profitability and clouding long-term planning, and narrows the PFAS customer-preference reference to products without third-party manufactured PFAS.
labels.rationale: criterion 1: tariffs and trade restrictions are a newly disclosed exposure (criterion 2 also applies to the new trade-restriction reference, and criterion 3 to the narrowed PFAS scope).

labels.description: The opening words change from "This ability" to "The ability to successfully bring new products to market" with the rest of the text unchanged.
labels.rationale: minor: stylistic rewording that spells out the antecedent with identical meaning.

labels.description: Military conflicts are dropped as a named example of events that could interrupt or terminate supplier relationships and are replaced by a pointer to the disruptive events in the first risk factor (which now covers tariffs and trade restrictions), alongside minor wording changes ("shortage" to "shortages", "interrupted or terminated").
labels.rationale: criterion 2: a specific type of event (military conflicts) is dropped from the list of supply disruption causes and replaced with a reference to newly disclosed trade-restriction events, which is more than a cross-reference update.

labels.description: Only colons are added after "could" and "risk of" and page-number and table-of-contents artifacts move; the cybersecurity disclosure is otherwise identical.
labels.rationale: minor: punctuation and page-break formatting only.

labels.description: New risk factor on the Company's use of artificial intelligence, covering inaccurate or biased outputs, third-party AI vendor dependence, leakage of confidential or third-party data into AI systems, evolving AI regulation, competitive pressure, and resulting legal, regulatory and reputational harm.

The description of the structural reorganization (shrinking the corporate center, simplifying the supply chain, streamlining the geographic footprint, removing management layers, realigning go-to-market models and cutting manufacturing roles to match production volumes) is deleted and replaced with a general statement that workforce restructuring is expected to deliver benefits but also affects business groups, functions and geographies.
labels.rationale: criterion 2: a specific named program (the structural reorganization and its stated actions, including manufacturing role reductions) is dropped from the disclosure.

labels.description: Only a page-number and table-of-contents artifact is removed; the pension and postretirement plan text is identical.

The S&P Global Ratings outlook on 3M's BBB+ credit rating changes from negative to stable, while the Moody's A3 stable and Fitch A- stable ratings are unchanged and "Fitch" is renamed "Fitch Ratings".
labels.rationale: criterion 4: a rating (the S&P outlook) changes from negative to stable, which also softens the stated risk under criterion 3.

labels.description: The cross-reference to the Commitments and Contingencies footnote changes from Note 19 to Note 17, and a page-break artifact is added, with the CAE Settlement terms ($6.0 billion, 2023 to 2029, more than 99% participation) unchanged.
labels.rationale: minor: cross-reference update and page-break formatting only.

labels.description: The risk that consents or approvals required for the Solventum separation will not be obtained, or will be obtained subject to material modifications to the underlying arrangements, is deleted.
labels.rationale: criterion 1: a previously disclosed risk is removed.
